method: saved original observations, finite-command intervals and one current Gaussian K record per update; uniform-time posthoc FK samples reuse saved auxiliary equilibrium angles; no estimator/control rerun or truth injection
limitations: Current JSONL byte frontiers and physical completion are recorded separately from full raw/estimation drain.
K is an effective auxiliary-model parameter; orientation fit and physical hand accuracy are separate measurements.
Moment queries use the existing Bingham-derived local approximation; no exact nonlinear distribution claim.
Posthoc physical scoring does not install true K, realized joints or target truth into estimation.
Matching IDs, finite reference checks and passing audits do not establish arrival or stability.
Collision checking remains a separately reported simulation setting.

camera_detection.loss_interval_rule: From the first captured image with no detected marker to the first recovered capture; these are image timestamps, not exact continuous visibility boundaries.

reaching_objective.covariance_interpretation: Covariance and full hand/goal cross remain diagnostic data. Their trace contributes to S only for the explicitly recorded expected-squared-distance objective; squared-mean-distance selection scores corrected means alone.

body_bayes_factor_surprise.interpretation: Saved body change updates only; K surprise remains disabled. Finite residuals are diagnostics, not update acceptance or stopping conditions. Missing legacy records are not invented as disabled updates. The projected numerator reference ID identifies its actual Keep chart; canonical identity is checked separately.

finite_plan_posthoc_response.scope: Each plan uses its saved fixed-law prediction and physical frames at adoption and the first frame at or after its finite duration. Physical settling after this boundary and changes from subsequent observations are not attributed to this single plan. Covariance-trace changes remain diagnostics and are not described as score contributions for squared-mean-distance selection.

squared_mean_objective_scalar_audit.scope: Every saved finite-plan selection uses its captured law and K. Historical expected squared error is read-only diagnosis; no criterion or candidate change.
